sources.title: Gesetzliche Feiertage, Allerseelentag, Festtage der Landespatrone
sources.supports: each state's patron-saint day, listed separately from the statutory public holidays, as a school-free day (read directly)

public_holidays: No state-only statutory public holidays: Austria's public holidays are national and are on Austria's record.
culture-cycles.note: The patron-saint day is a school holiday in this state. The ministry lists it apart from the statutory public holidays, so do not assume shops or businesses close; the ministry page does not say.
